params.body:
**Carries a migration** (two: `dealers.allow_delegated_access`, and the tables `delegation_logs` + `delegation_actions`), allowed after cutover step 2.

## What changes for the user

Until now "log in as" (`user/loginas/{id}`, role 1 only) flushed the session and logged the administrator in as the user: no way back but logging out, no trace of what was done, no say for the dealer. It is now **delegated access** (new chapter P2-11 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`):

- **Opt-in per dealer.** On the dealer's own company sheet (`ownuser/{id}/edit`, section "Hulp van Stocklist-beheer") a switch "Stocklist-beheer mag in mijn account meekijken en helpen" with one line saying what an administrator can then do and that everything is recorded. Only whoever may save that sheet (edit right on `ownuser`, which is what makes a user the dealer's administrator) sees the switch; the administrator's dealer sheet shows the dealer's choice read-only, and `DealerController::update` drops the field on the admin route and while a delegation is running. Default off.
- **`App\Support\Delegation`**: `start()` (platform admin only, dealer consent required, never an administrator as target, never on top of a running delegation), `stop()`, `active()`, `record()`. The admin's id stays in the session, `Auth::login($target)` without flushing, rights reloaded the way a login does. The old route and its name still work and land on the home page as before; a refusal returns to where the click came from with the reason as a toast.
- **Bar** on every page the delegated admin sees, phone included: amber ground, "Je werkt als <naam> (<dealer>)" and "Terug naar mijn account" (POST `delegation.stop`). The top bar and page move down under it; the bar measures its own height when it wraps on a phone.
- **Trail**: `delegation_logs` (admin, target, dealer, started_at, ended_at, ip, user_agent) and one `delegation_actions` row per write request (anything but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS: method, path, route name, at) via `LogDelegatedActions` in the web group. Reads are not recorded. Livewire requests are named by component and method (`livewire stocklist-wagenlijst.markSold`); polls and pure `$refresh`/`$set` calls are skipped, otherwise the bell's poll would fill the trail. Logout closes the row.
- **Mail** to the dealer's administrators (fallback: the dealer's general address) when a delegation starts: "Stocklist-beheer is ingelogd in jouw account om te helpen", with who, as whom, when; in the recipient's language; `Mail::alwaysTo` in debug applies. A mail failure never undoes the delegation.
- **Log page** `settings/delegation-log` (`delegation.log`, admins only, 403 otherwise): sessions newest first, actions under each on request, filter by dealer; linked from the dealers overview.
- **User lists**: "Inloggen als" only for dealers that opted in and never on an administrator; otherwise a disabled button with the tooltip "Deze dealer heeft meekijken niet toegestaan".
- Translations in nl, fr, en, de (`lang/*/delegation.php`).

## Rules and open point

- New section P2-11 (R P2-11.1 to R P2-11.7); R P2-2.8 rewritten to point at it.
- `docs/bedrijfsregels/open-punten/2026-09-15-2fa-en-passkeys.md`: plan for TOTP + recovery codes (Fortify), e-mail as an accepted second factor, passkeys (WebAuthn), opt-in per user under "Mijn profiel", after the cutover, decided by Shane. It records the session facts as they are today: `SESSION_LIFETIME` 120 minutes, and the login form's "Aangemeld blijven" checkbox does nothing because `LoginController::login` calls `Auth::loginUsingId()` without the remember flag; Shane's requirements (stay logged in for weeks, 2FA rarely, e-mail code as a factor) are written in.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/DelegationTest.php` (17 tests): start refused without opt-in (nothing written, no mail); start keeps the session and the bar renders; stop returns the admin and closes the row; write recorded, read not; Livewire naming and poll skipping; nothing recorded outside a delegation; mail to the dealer admin and to the general address without one; admin target refused; non-admin and stacked delegation refused; old route works and delegates; old route refuses without consent with the reason; user list hides the action without consent; log page admin-only, lists sessions and actions, filters by dealer; consent only written from the own sheet, not from the admin sheet, not while delegating; logout closes the trail.

Filter `Delegat|LoginAs|User|Settings|Mail|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|CompiledViews|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|LanguageParity|BuildContract`: OK (175 tests, 1473 assertions, 1 pre-existing incomplete in RulesDocsBuild).

## Screenshots

`.playwright-mcp/delegation/` in the worktree: `bar-1440.png`, `bar-390.png`, `switch-1440.png`, `switch-390.png`, `switch-locked-while-delegating-390.png`, `log-1440.png`, `log-390.png`, `admin-dealer-sheet-1440.png`.
params.title: Delegated access: an admin can help inside a dealer's account, with consent and a trail
